info.title: Capture The Feature Flag Core API
info.description: Projects, environments, flags and targeting, and the endpoints Evaluators poll.

key.description: The project key: lowercase kebab-case, immutable after creation.
The current project key, if sent. It cannot be changed.

sdkKey.description: The opaque, generated key an SDK uses to say which environment it evaluates in.

key.description: The environment key: lowercase kebab-case, immutable after creation.
The current environment key, if sent. It cannot be changed.

sdkKey.description: The current SDK key, if sent. It cannot be changed.

on.description: Targeting on or off. While off, every context gets the off variation.

variations.description: The ordered variations; targeting refers to them by index. Boolean flags are always [true, false].

version.description: Incremented on every edit; send it back with the next edit.

managedBy.description: The tool managing the flag as code: "terraform" when the Terraform provider manages it, null otherwise. The admin app shows a badge and warns before edits. It is informational: it does not lock the flag.

archived.description: Whether the flag is archived: hidden from the flag list and left out of snapshots, so SDKs get their fallback value with FLAG_NOT_FOUND. Restoring it brings back its targeting as it was.

archivedAt.description: When the flag was archived, or null while it is not.

targeting.description: The flag's targeting on or off in every environment of the project, in the environments' order.

key.description: The flag key: lowercase kebab-case, immutable after creation.

managedBy.description: The tool managing the flag as code: "terraform" when the Terraform provider manages it, null otherwise. The admin app shows a badge and warns before edits. It is informational: it does not lock the flag.

variations.description: The ordered variations; targeting refers to them by index. Boolean flags are always [true, false].

version.description: Incremented on every edit; send it back with the next edit.

managedBy.description: The tool managing the flag as code: "terraform" when the Terraform provider manages it, null otherwise. The admin app shows a badge and warns before edits. It is informational: it does not lock the flag.

archived.description: Whether the flag is archived: hidden from the flag list and left out of snapshots, so SDKs get their fallback value with FLAG_NOT_FOUND. Restoring it brings back its targeting as it was.

archivedAt.description: When the flag was archived, or null while it is not.

version.description: The version this edit is based on. An outdated version is rejected with 409.

key.description: The current flag key, if sent. It cannot be changed.

managedBy.description: The tool managing the flag as code: "terraform" when the Terraform provider manages it, null otherwise. The admin app shows a badge and warns before edits. It is informational: it does not lock the flag. Send null to clear it.

variation.description: Index into the flag variations served to the listed user IDs.

userIds.description: The user IDs always served this variation while targeting is on. Each is a non-empty string.

attribute.description: The context attribute the rule tests.

operator.description: in: the attribute is one of the values. not_in: it is none of them. A missing attribute never matches.

values.description: For country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes (stored in uppercase); for user_id, non-empty user IDs.

variation.description: Index into the flag variations served when the rule matches.

on.description: Targeting on or off. While off, every context gets the off variation.

offVariation.description: Index into the flag variations served while targeting is off.

defaultVariation.description: Index into the flag variations served when no individual target or rule matches.

rules.description: Ordered; the first rule that matches wins.

version.description: Incremented on every change; send it back with the next change.
The version this change is based on. An outdated version is rejected with 409.

offVariation.description: Index into the flag variations served while targeting is off.

defaultVariation.description: Index into the flag variations served when targeting is on and no individual target or rule matches.

individualTargets.description: Replaces the individual targets. At most one per variation, and a user ID in only one of them.

rules.description: Replaces the rules. Ordered; the first rule that matches wins.

environments.description: Every environment of every project, by SDK key.

flags.description: Every flag of the project, ordered by flag key.

minute.description: The start of the minute; seconds are ignored.

country.description: An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, in any case.

sdkKey.description: The SDK key of the environment. Telemetry for an unknown one is skipped.

metricRetentionDays.description: How many days evaluation count buckets are kept.

seenContextRetentionDays.description: How many days a seen context is kept after it was last seen.

seenContextCap.description: How many seen contexts are kept per environment: the most recently seen.

staleFlagThresholdDays.description: After how many days without evaluations in any environment a flag counts as stale.

metricRetentionDays.description: How many days evaluation count buckets are kept.

seenContextRetentionDays.description: How many days a seen context is kept after it was last seen.

seenContextCap.description: How many seen contexts are kept per environment: the most recently seen.

staleFlagThresholdDays.description: After how many days without evaluations in any environment a flag counts as stale.

id.description: Increases with every entry: a higher id is a later entry.

targetId.description: The id of the project, environment, flag or targeting changed.

flagKey.description: The flag of a flag or targeting entry.

environmentKey.description: The environment of an environment or targeting entry.

actor.description: Who made the change, from the X-CTFF-Actor header.

before.description: The target before the change; null for a create.

after.description: The target after the change; null for a delete.

nextCursor.description: The cursor of the next (older) page, or null when this is the last one.

on.description: Flags (not archived) with targeting on in the environment.

off.description: Flags (not archived) with targeting off in the environment.

flagCount.description: The flags of the project, archived flags left out.

archivedFlagCount.description: The archived flags of the project.

environments.description: Every environment of the project, in the environments' order.

count.description: Never 0: buckets without evaluations are left out.

environmentKey.description: The environment asked for, or null for all of them.

bucketMinutes.description: The size of each bucket, in minutes.

from.description: The start of the first bucket.

to.description: The end of the last bucket, exclusive: it is in the future.

counts.description: Oldest first, then by environment, flag and variation; only buckets with evaluations.

lastEvaluatedAt.description: The start of the last minute it was evaluated in, in any environment, or null when the count buckets kept (see the metric retention) have none.

thresholdDays.description: The stale-flag threshold of the settings, in days.

flags.description: Never evaluated first, then the longest without evaluations; then by key.

ContextAttributeType.description: `string`: any non-empty string. `country_code`: an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, compared in uppercase.

key.description: Its name in contexts and rules.

type.description: `string`: any non-empty string. `country_code`: an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, compared in uppercase.

builtIn.description: Built-in attributes cannot be edited. In V1 every attribute is built in.

context.description: The context to evaluate every flag for.

ruleIndex.description: For `RULE_MATCH`: the index, in the targeting’s ordered rules, of the first rule that matched.

value.description: The variation served; null for an error.

variationIndex.description: Index into the flag variations; null for an error.

context.description: The context evaluated, as evaluations see it: `country` in uppercase.

flags.description: Every flag of the project that is not archived, ordered by flag key.
